1879064296.name: Turn the Tables
1879064296.desc: When dazed, stunned, or knocked down: recover from impairing effects and inflict them upon your enemy instead.

conditionalEffects.description: Turn the Tables grants immunity to all disables for 10s.

procEffects.description: DNT - Whenever you are hit by an attack, your Block/parry Ratings will increase by X.
DNT - Whenever you block an attack, you will gain a small amount of critical defence.
Up to once per second, when you Block or Partially Block:

1879139048.name: Flea Bitten
1879139048.desc: You shake fleas onto your target, slowing their actions and making it difficult to focus.

1879157608.name: Cry of the Enduring
1879157608.desc: A  buff that increases coloured armour for a long time.

1879198312.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Blackpaw-bear)
1879198312.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879228136.name: Spear and Shield
1879228136.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their spear and shield for attack.

1879232488.name: Nature Spirit (Spirit Sabre-cat)
1879232488.desc: Your bond with the natural world allows you to call upon old friends long gone.

1879263720.name: Eyes of the Hunter
1879263720.desc: The embodiment of a natural-born predator, you are able to share your secrets of the hunt with those around you.

1879273448.name: Pony of Plenty
1879273448.desc: A pony from the Farmers Faire.

1879275752.name: Empowerment
1879275752.desc: You see your enemy fall before you and are eager for the rest to join him.

1879277416.name: Writ of Lightning
1879277416.desc: Deals lightning damage and lowers target's Tactical Mitigation.\n\nThis effect stacks up to 3 times.

conditionalEffects.description: Writ of Lightning increases enemy inductions by 8% and attack duration by 5% per tier.

1879313000.name: Lûtkal's Memories
1879313000.desc: Lûtkal was a master of the sword and shield in life, but they avail him nothing now. Above all else he misses the life he lived with his wife and children, before the coming of Isildur.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Lûtkal cannot use the skills he had in life, cursed as he is to an undying existence.</rgb>

1879352168.name: Steed of the Alliance of the Third Age
1879352168.desc: A steed representing the combined forces who faced Sauron towards the end of the Third Age.

1879384936.name: Bat Whirl
1879384936.desc: Apparently you have startled a colony of bats into swirling flight.

1879391464.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Warrior)
1879391464.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879412840.name: Mottled Craban
1879412840.desc: Summons a craban to watch over you.

1879449576.name: Lesser Anthem III - Composure
1879449576.desc: Anthem: Increases Resistances, Tactical Mitigation, and Shadow, Acid, and Fire Mitigation of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 1 ballad buff present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879463016.name: Young Moose
1879463016.desc: Summons a young moose to accompany you on your journeys.

1879464168.name: Muster at Pelargir
1879464168.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Pelargir in King's Gondor.

1879488744.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879488744.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879497704.name: Major Pet Command
1879497704.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506536.name: Acid-spike
1879506536.desc: Send a spike of acid at your target, weakening them.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879506664.name: Devotion: Umbral Pall
1879506664.desc: Devoting yourself to the shadow, your ancient blood channels the dark knowledge taught to your ancestors by the first masters of the shadow that spread across Middle-earth. With this power, you transform your damaging skills into shadow-based damage skills, potent enhancements for yourself and detriments for your enemies, and gain access to even further powers from the fell shadows.
